label: FP
reason: The user-provided header name is escaped via StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml before being used in the response, which effectively neutralizes any potential cross-site scripting attack by converting malicious characters into HTML entities. The alert incorrectly identifies a vulnerability when the actual control flow includes explicit escaping of the input prior to rendering.

evidence.note: bar is derived from param via StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml, preventing XSS
